cards.example_en: Art students combine red and blue to get purple.
cards.example_zh: 美术班的学生把红色和蓝色调成紫色。

cards.example_en: We laughed all through the comedy that the drama club put on.
cards.example_zh: 戏剧社演的那出喜剧，我们从头笑到尾。

cards.example_en: A warm blanket and hot tea brought comfort after the cold game.
cards.example_zh: 一场寒冷的比赛之后，暖毯子和热茶带来了安慰。

cards.example_en: He reads a comic on the bus.
cards.example_zh: 他在公交车上看漫画。

cards.example_en: Ms Lee wrote one kind comment beside my messy diagram.
cards.example_zh: 李老师在我凌乱的图旁边写了一句善意的评论。

cards.example_en: The commercial centre is near the station.
cards.example_zh: 商业中心在车站附近。

cards.example_en: He committed himself to the project.
cards.example_zh: 他承诺投入这个项目。

cards.example_en: She made a commitment to practise daily.
cards.example_zh: 她承诺每天练习。

cards.example_en: The sports committee moved the final to the indoor court.
cards.example_zh: 体育委员会把决赛改到了室内球场。

cards.example_en: Poor communication made the relay team drop the baton twice.
cards.example_zh: 交流没做好，接力队两次把接力棒掉在了地上。

cards.example_en: They studied communist ideas in history class.
cards.example_zh: 他们在历史课上学习共产主义思想。

cards.example_en: A quick comparison showed the bus pass costs less than daily tickets.
cards.example_zh: 简单一比较就发现，公交月票比每天买票更便宜。

cards.example_en: The job needs competence in English.
cards.example_zh: 这份工作需要英语能力。

cards.example_en: She won first prize in the speech competition.
cards.example_zh: 她在竞赛中获得一等奖。

cards.example_en: Don't complain about the homework.
cards.example_zh: 不要抱怨作业。

cards.example_en: The problem looks complex at first.
cards.example_zh: 这个问题乍看很复杂。

cards.example_en: The instructions are too complicated.
cards.example_zh: 说明太复杂了。

cards.example_en: The missing component was a tiny screw from the robot's arm.
cards.example_zh: 缺少的那个组成部分是机器人手臂上的一颗小螺丝。

cards.example_en: She can compose a short song.
cards.example_zh: 她能创作一首短歌。

cards.example_en: Hand in your composition tomorrow.
cards.example_zh: 明天交作文。

cards.example_en: The comprehension passage is about oceans.
cards.example_zh: 这篇阅读理解讲的是海洋。

cards.example_en: This comprehensive guide lists every bus that passes the school.
cards.example_zh: 这本全面的指南列出了经过学校的每一路公交。

cards.example_en: The concert will comprise three short songs and a dance.
cards.example_zh: 这场音乐会将包括三首短歌和一支舞蹈。

cards.example_en: Concentrate on the listening test and ignore the noise.
cards.example_zh: 做听力测试时要集中注意力，别管噪音。

cards.example_en: The concept is easy to understand.
cards.example_zh: 这个概念很容易理解。

cards.example_en: Exam results concern my parents more than sports scores.
cards.example_zh: 我父母更关注考试成绩，而不是体育分数。

cards.example_en: These results let us conclude that the plant needs more sun.
cards.example_zh: 这些结果让我们得出结论：这种植物需要更多阳光。

cards.example_en: Write a short conclusion at the end.
cards.example_zh: 在结尾写一个简短的结论。

cards.example_en: The path is made of concrete.
cards.example_zh: 这条小路是混凝土铺的。

cards.example_en: Teachers conduct experiments in the lab.
cards.example_zh: 老师在实验室做实验。

cards.example_en: Parents packed the hall for a conference on school meals.
cards.example_zh: 家长们挤满礼堂，来参加关于学校餐食的会议。

cards.example_en: Please confirm your booking by email.
cards.example_zh: 请通过电子邮件确认您的预订。

cards.example_en: There is a conflict between work and family.
cards.example_zh: 工作和家庭之间存在冲突。

cards.example_en: The course introduces Confucianism.
cards.example_zh: 这门课介绍儒家思想。

cards.example_en: Confucius was a great teacher.
cards.example_zh: 孔子是一位伟大的老师。

cards.example_en: I was confused by the instructions.
cards.example_zh: 我被说明弄糊涂了。

cards.example_en: Every choice has a consequence.
cards.example_zh: 每个选择都有一个后果。

cards.example_en: Wildlife conservation needs everyone's help.
cards.example_zh: 野生动物保护需要每个人的帮助。

cards.example_en: The dinner will consist of rice, soup, and fish.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭将由米饭、汤和鱼组成。

cards.example_en: Her results have been consistent all year.
cards.example_zh: 她全年的成绩都很稳定。

cards.example_en: The baby needs constant attention.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝需要持续的照看。

cards.example_en: The constitution protects basic rights.
cards.example_zh: 宪法保护基本权利。

cards.example_en: Construction beside the playground made it hard to hear the teacher.
cards.example_zh: 操场旁边在施工，我们很难听清老师的话。

cards.example_en: A sleep consultant told my cousin to put his phone away at night.
cards.example_zh: 一位睡眠顾问让我表哥晚上把手机收起来。

cards.example_en: A short consultation with the nurse settled my worry about the rash.
cards.example_zh: 向护士简短请教之后，我对那片皮疹就不担心了。

cards.example_en: Cars consume a lot of fuel.
cards.example_zh: 汽车消耗大量燃料。

cards.example_en: Juice consumption in our canteen doubles when the weather is hot.
cards.example_zh: 天气一热，我们食堂的果汁消费就会翻倍。

cards.example_en: Contact the teacher if you have a question.
cards.example_zh: 如果有问题，请联系老师。

cards.example_en: This box may contain fragile items.
cards.example_zh: 这个箱子可能装有易碎物品。

cards.example_en: Contemporary dance was the highlight of the talent show.
cards.example_zh: 当代舞是才艺表演中最精彩的部分。

word.example_en: Please leave a comment on this draft.
word.example_zh: 请在这篇草稿上留下评语。

word.example_en: Do not complain about the weather all day.
Please concentrate on the first paragraph.
word.example_zh: 请把注意力集中在第一段。

word.example_en: Concern for safety shaped the rule.
word.example_zh: 对安全的关心促成了这条规则。

word.example_en: There is concern about the river level.
word.example_zh: 人们对河流水位有忧虑。

word.example_en: In conclusion, the data support the claim.
word.example_zh: 最后总之，数据支持这个说法。

word.example_en: Real skill can consist in staying calm.
word.example_zh: 真正的本事可以在于保持冷静。

word.example_en: The group will consist of five students.
word.example_zh: 这个小组将由五名学生组成。
